chunks: As for the right of your self against you,

is that you employ it fully in obeying God; then you deliver to your tongue its right, to your hearing its right, to your sight its right, to your hand its right, to your leg its right, to your stomach its right, to your private part its right, and you seek help from God in all that.
ai.seo_question: What are the specific rights of the body's organs according to Imam al-Sadiq in Risalat al-Huquq?
